new_hypothesis: Represent scratch points as s16[18][3] instead of an array of three-field structs, changing aggregate lowering and alias information without changing the six-byte point representation. Then vary local declaration order to align callee-saved register allocation.
accepted_changes: s16 points[18][3], with equivalent indexed component accesses and Vec3s pointer casts only at existing call boundaries.
Move s16 offset and step declarations immediately after count; retain original order of the remaining locals.

score_progression.variant: restore original bound order after moving offset/step

rejected_hypotheses: Flat scalar indexing, byte-offset addressing, component pointers, union views, and output array representation. Byte-offset stores did serialize extrapolation but changed indexed stores to an added destination base with displaced stores and increased size.
Shared int delta; shared s16/int source values; compound assignments. Unlike prior shared-s16-delta experiment, these did not intentionally truncate the subtraction.
Widened offset/step/bounds, separate loop counter, and explicit first-loop points iterator; none improved the final retained score.
Volatile source loads (not the prior volatile destination experiment) increased size; not retained.
Three-component loops were automatically unrolled, but changed address formation and increased size.
Local inline C component/vector/expression helpers all inlined but worsened matching; none retained.
A restrict-qualified pointer trial was rejected by the existing compiler (semicolon expected); no flags or policy were changed.
